p, k = map(int, input().split())
mark = [False] * p
total_cycles = 0

def traverse(start):
    x = start
    while not mark[x]:
        mark[x] = True
        x = (x * k) % p

for i in range(p):
    if not mark[i]:
        total_cycles += 1
        traverse(i)

answer = 1
for _ in range(1, total_cycles + (k == 1) + 1):
    answer = (answer * p) % 1000000007

print(answer)
